_comment: Benchmarked on CANBK across 6 local models (see LLM_runs analysis). nemotron-bolt-e4b-16k won the Decision Maker outright, tied qwen3-30b on fundamental/trader, cited real numbers, completed 11/11, and is small enough to stay resident in RAM so the 10 concurrent agents never trigger an Ollama model swap. That makes it the best + most reliable single-model choice. 32GB+ RAM users wanting max depth can replace every 'model' value with 'qwen3-30b-a3b-16k:latest' (ranked #1 overall) - it is a 3B-active MoE so inference stays fast, it just needs ~18GB resident.
